metadata.title: Sun-Drenched Country Portrait with Geometric Overlays

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sun-saturated portrait of a man in a cowboy hat featuring horizontal light streaks and thin, geometric sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: dark or moody aesthetics are required
heavy serif or script fonts are requested
urban or industrial settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and shirt, set against a bright sky. The image is characterized by intense warm light leaks, horizontal motion-blurred streaks of yellow and orange, and a vertical textured element on the left. The typography is integrated into the light effects, using thin, overlapping geometric lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered but framed by a vertical textured pillar on the left
Horizontal light streaks bisecting the lower third of the composition
Typography anchored to the left-center and bottom-right quadrants
Warm golden light leaks overlapping the subject's face and hat
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat as a primary silhouette
High-key warm color palette dominated by amber and cyan
Thin-stroke geometric sans-serif typography with overlapping characters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the cowboy hat against the bright sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the vertical line of the left pillar, then moves across the horizontal light streaks to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright, blown-out sky in the upper right provides breathing room for the subject's profile.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and golden yellow (light leaks and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows; high value contrast between the dark clothing and the bright background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'M' use wide, splayed legs
The 'R' has a high waist and a straight diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and stacked arrangements.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin stroke potential.
Provides the necessary sharp vertices and geometric foundation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and black shirt against a bright sky. Apply heavy warm light leaks, horizontal yellow motion-blur streaks across the bottom, and a vertical orange-textured pillar on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay thin, geometric sans-serif text in two blocks. One block on the left-center and a larger stacked block in the bottom-right. Use a red-to-black vertical gradient on the letters and ensure characters slightly overlap.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat silhouette distinct?
Are the light leaks warm and sun-drenched?
Is the typography hairline-thin and geometric?
Do the letters in the text blocks overlap?

mustRedesign: Any use of thick or serif fonts

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of light effects and subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for hairline stroke consistency in text
Verify horizontal light streaks don't obscure the face
Ensure the vertical left element has a rusted or sun-damaged texture
Confirm the color palette remains strictly warm with cyan sky accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Cowboy Hat + Geometric Hairline Type + Horizontal Light Streaks + Warm Gradient Overlays
